definitions.explanation: Containing no artificial additives such as preservatives, colorings, or flavorings. Commonly seen on food and cosmetic labels.

examples.japanese: {無添加|むてんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石鹸|せっけん}→石鹸：04981_sekken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無添加|むてんか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This soy sauce is additive-free and good for your health.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無添加|むてんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べさせたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I want to feed my children additive-free food.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{添加|てんか}→添加：13353_tenka⟧ (addition/additive). A marketing and labeling term frequently seen on product packaging in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無添加|むてんか}⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ — additive-free food
- {無添加|むてんか}⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧ — additive-free cosmetics
- {無添加|むてんか}⟦{石鹸|せっけん}→石鹸：04981_sekken⟧ — additive-free soap
- {無添加|むてんか}・⟦{無着色|むちゃくしょく}→無着色：29231_muchakushoku⟧ — no additives, no artificial coloring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無農薬|むのうやく}→無農薬：19133_munouyaku⟧ — pesticide-free
- オーガニック — organic
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧ — natural (often used for ingredients)
